title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Short demos
hook: How long does it take you to explain a drill?
intro: You explain the drill in detail.
Kids start fidgeting by the second minute.
statement: Kids learn more from seeing than from listening.
q1: Do you show a quick demo and start right away —
q2: or explain fully so it runs right the first time?
q3: What could you cut from your explanation?
t1: Every coach is different. But drills start faster
t2: when kids see it once and try it.
cta: Coaches — how long are your demos?
ctaLines: Show it once. Walk it through. Start and fix.
ctaPrompt: Share your teaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How long does it take you to explain a drill?
You explain the drill in detail. Kids start fidgeting by the second minute.
Kids learn more from seeing than from listening.
A quick demo or a full explanation. Both can work.
How long are your demos? Share your habit in the comments.
